title: CFA Level I
summary: One-to-one CFA Level I coaching built around official curriculum questions, error diagnosis, and real-world application.
audience: Designed for committed CFA Level I candidates who want personal guidance. Not intended as a passive lecture series, and no pass is guaranteed.
difference:
Pass the Exam. Master the Markets.
Standard prep just teaches the book. We bridge CFA theory with real-world application, ensuring you build the skills of a top-tier analyst.

method.title: Learn
method.description: Each topic starts with the format that suits the candidate: independent study, tutor-led teaching, or a mix.

method.title: Solve
method.description: Official curriculum questions are worked through in session. The candidate explains their reasoning, and the cause of each error is identified: concept, formula, interpretation, calculation, or timing.

method.title: Apply
method.description: Each topic ends with a short practical task, such as a spreadsheet, company report, bond-pricing exercise, or investment decision.

method.title: Revise
method.description: Short, spaced reviews revisit earlier topics through recall quizzes, retried errors, and mixed question sets.

modes.title: Self-study
modes.description: Candidate studies the curriculum independently. Sessions focus on questions and weak areas.

modes.title: Tutor-led
modes.description: The tutor teaches the topic live, followed immediately by question work.

modes.title: Hybrid
modes.description: Candidate reads first. The tutor teaches only the sections that remain unclear.

modules.title: Ethical and Professional Standards
modules.summary: Apply the Code and Standards to real situations and defend the decision.
modules.coaching: Scenario questions are attempted first. Each answer option is reviewed to identify which Standard applies and why.
modules.practice: Walk through a realistic conflict-of-interest case and decide the correct action.
modules.deliverable: One-page case note citing the Standard and the reasoning.

modules.title: Quantitative Methods
modules.summary: Build the tools used across valuation, risk and portfolio decisions.
modules.coaching: Official curriculum practice problems are attempted. Calculation, formula and interpretation errors are diagnosed.
modules.practice: Build a return, risk and compounding worksheet.
modules.deliverable: Build a return, risk and compounding worksheet.

modules.title: Financial Statement Analysis
modules.summary: Read financial statements as evidence of company quality, not as a list of ratios.
modules.coaching: Ratio, revenue recognition and cash-flow questions are reviewed, including why each wrong option looked plausible.
modules.practice: Read a listed company’s annual report and form an analyst-style view.
modules.deliverable: Short company note with a ratio table and open questions.

modules.title: Equities
modules.summary: Estimate what a company is worth and state the assumptions behind it.
modules.coaching: Valuation-method questions are reviewed. The choice of model and inputs is checked.
modules.practice: Download a company’s data and build a basic valuation snapshot.
modules.deliverable: One-page valuation snapshot with an assumptions table.

modules.title: Fixed Income
modules.summary: Understand how bond prices respond to interest rates, and why.
modules.coaching: Understand how bond prices respond to interest rates, and why.
modules.practice: Price a bond and test its sensitivity to a rate change.
modules.deliverable: Bond pricing sheet with a rate-shock table.

modules.title: Derivatives and Risk Management
modules.summary: Understand how derivatives transfer risk and what each position pays off.
modules.coaching: Payoff and pricing-logic questions are reviewed. Position direction and payoff shape are checked.
modules.practice: Draw payoff diagrams for a simple hedge.
modules.deliverable: Payoff chart set for a hedging example.

modules.title: Economics
modules.summary: Read economic news and trace its effect on rates, currencies and markets.
modules.coaching: Concept questions are attempted first. The reasoning chain is reviewed from cause to market effect.
modules.practice: Read a central bank statement and note the likely effect on rates and the currency.

modules.title: Alternative Investments
modules.summary: Compare alternative assets with listed investments on return, risk, liquidity and fees.
modules.coaching: Feature, fee-structure and risk questions are reviewed. Look-alike asset types are separated.
modules.practice: Compare one alternative investment with a listed fund.
modules.deliverable: Comparison table with a short conclusion.

modules.title: Corporate Finance
modules.summary: Judge whether a project or financing decision creates value.
modules.coaching: NPV, IRR, capital budgeting and cost-of-capital questions are reviewed. Errors in cash-flow setup and discount rates are diagnosed.
modules.practice: Compare two investment projects in a spreadsheet.
modules.deliverable: Project comparison sheet with a recommendation.

modules.title: Portfolio Construction
modules.summary: Project comparison sheet with a recommendation.
modules.coaching: Risk-return, diversification and policy questions are reviewed. Each answer is tied to client constraints.
modules.practice: Draft a simple Investment Policy Statement for a fictional client.

options.title: CFA Level I Comprehensive Coaching
options.description: End-to-end guidance through the entire CFA Level I curriculum. Includes a customized study plan anchored to your exam date, step-by-step concept breakdowns, and continuous support from day one to exam day. Flexible payment plans available.

options.title: Targeted Topic Pack
options.description: Focused, intensive coaching on high-weight or complex areas (e.g., Fixed Income, FSA). Designed to solidify your understanding of critical concepts, diagnose calculation errors, and improve your scoring in specific problem areas.

options.title: Final-month revision sprint
options.description: An intensive 4-to-6 week program designed for the final stretch before your exam window. Includes thorough mock-exam reviews, strategic time-management techniques, and targeted drills to strengthen your remaining weak areas.

options.title: Single session
options.description: A dedicated one-on-one session to tackle specific hurdles, clarify complex formulas, or walk through challenging curriculum questions. Ideal for targeted, immediate help with no long-term

faqs.question: How is this different from a regular CFA course?
faqs.answer: A regular course teaches a fixed lecture plan to a group. This coaching is one-to-one and built around the candidate’s own attempts at official curriculum questions. Each error is traced to its cause, whether concept, formula, interpretation, calculation or timing. Each topic then ends with a short practical task.

faqs.question: Can the tutor teach topics, or is it only question practice?
faqs.answer: Both are available. Each topic can be studied independently, taught live by the tutor, or handled as a hybrid where the candidate reads first and the tutor covers only the unclear parts. The format can change from one topic to the next.

faqs.question: Is the CFA Institute curriculum still needed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Registered candidates access the curriculum, practice questions and mock exams through the CFA Institute Learning Ecosystem. Sessions are built around that material, not around separate notes. Finance in Practice is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CFA Institute.

faqs.question: Can coaching start at any time, and how are sessions priced?
faqs.answer: Coaching can begin on request, with no fixed cohort start date. Sessions can be booked singly, monthly, or as exam-season support. Fees are discussed after the free Portfolio Review, because the scope depends on the candidate’s needs.

faqs.question: Does coaching guarantee a pass?
faqs.answer: No. Results depend on the candidate’s preparation and effort. Coaching improves the quality of practice by finding the cause of each error and a clear next step.
